This page lists the spec and status fields of Identity, Role, RolesAssignment, Policy and OIDCProvider, each with its type, its limits and its description. The [Platform page](../../../platform/security-and-networking/security.md) explains the concept, and the `metadata` of every kind is [the same](../../common-definitions.md#objectmeta).

## Identity

::include[../../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/security/identity.yaml#identity]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `Identity` |

### `Identity.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `credentialSecretName` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The Secret, in the Identity's namespace, that funcd writes the credential to and deletes with the Identity: the S3 key pair as accessKeyId and secretAccessKey, and the Lake token as lakeToken. Empty means the Identity's name. funcd leaves alone a Secret of that name that no Identity of this name controls, and the Identity then stays Pending with reason SecretNotOwned; a Secret left by a deleted Identity of the same name is issued again. |
| `rotate` | integer | Raise it above status.observedRotate to rotate the credential: funcd writes a new secretAccessKey and lakeToken under the same access key id, and the old ones stop authenticating, with no overlap. |
| `type` | string, required, one of `external` | What the Identity stands for: external, a caller outside funcd that authenticates with the credential funcd issues. The credential grants nothing: a RolesAssignment or a Policy grants the Identity its access. |

### `Identity.status`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accessKeyId` | string | The access key id of the issued key pair, also in the Secret. funcd derives it from the Identity's namespace and name, so it stays the same when the credential rotates. |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `observedRotate` | integer | The spec.rotate value that funcd last acted on: a rotation is done once it equals spec.rotate. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Deploying`, `Ready`, `Idle`, `Degraded`, `Failed`, `Terminating` | Where the object is in its lifecycle. |

## Role

::include[../../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/security/role.yaml#role]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `Role` |

### `Role.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | array of string values, required | The actions the role grants, at least one, such as s3::read, kv::write or lake::query. An action that funcd does not know grants nothing. |

## RolesAssignment

::include[../../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/security/rolesassignment.yaml#rolesassignment]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `RolesAssignment` |

### `RolesAssignment.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `assignments` | array of [`RolesAssignment.spec.assignments[]`](#rolesassignmentspecassignments), required | The grants, at least one: each entry grants one role to a principal at a scope. funcd refuses an entry that sets no principal while spec.principal is unset, and likewise for the scope. |
| `principal` | object, [`RolesAssignment.spec.principal`](#rolesassignmentspecprincipal) | The principal of each entry that sets none. |
| `scope` | object, [`RolesAssignment.spec.scope`](#rolesassignmentspecscope) | The scope of each entry that sets none. |

### `RolesAssignment.spec.assignments[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `principal` | object, [`RolesAssignment.spec.principal`](#rolesassignmentspecprincipal) | Who the entry grants its role to. When unset, spec.principal. |
| `roleRef` | object, [`RolesAssignment.spec.assignments[].roleRef`](#rolesassignmentspecassignmentsroleref), required | The role the entry grants. |
| `scope` | object, [`RolesAssignment.spec.scope`](#rolesassignmentspecscope) | Where the entry's role applies. When unset, spec.scope. |

### `RolesAssignment.spec.assignments[].roleRef`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | string, required, one of `BuiltinRole`, `Role` | Where the role comes from: BuiltinRole for one of funcd's built-in roles, Role for a Role of the RolesAssignment's namespace. |
| `name` | string, required | The role's name. A built-in role is one of Blob Data Reader, Blob Data Writer, KV Data Reader, KV Data Writer, SQL Data Reader, SQL Data Writer, Secret Data Reader, Secret Data Writer, Lake Query Reader, Lake Contributor, Function Invoker, Reader, Contributor and Owner; the last three cover Bucket and KV data only. A name that matches no role grants nothing. |

### `RolesAssignment.spec.principal`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | string, required, one of `Function`, `Job`, `Identity` | The kind of the principal: a Function, a Job, whose runs' workers act as it, or an Identity for a caller outside funcd. |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The principal's name, in the RolesAssignment's namespace. funcd does not check that it exists. |

### `RolesAssignment.spec.scope`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | string, required, one of `Namespace`, `BucketPrefix`, `KVStore`, `Lake`, `SQLDatabase`, `Secret` | What the grant covers: with Namespace, every resource of the RolesAssignment's namespace; with another kind, the one resource that name gives, in that namespace. |
| `name` | string | The resource for each kind: &lt;bucket&gt;/&lt;prefix&gt; for one prefix of a Bucket, &lt;store&gt; for every table of a KVStore or &lt;store&gt;/&lt;table&gt; for one, &lt;lake&gt; for a Lake, &lt;database&gt; for a SQLDatabase and &lt;secret&gt; for a Secret. A Namespace scope covers the whole namespace, whatever its name. |

## Policy

::include[../../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/security/policy.yaml#policy]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `Policy` |

### `Policy.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cedar` | string, required | One or more Cedar permit or forbid statements, which apply with funcd's built-in rules to each request whose principal and resource are both in the Policy's namespace; a forbid wins over any permit. Each statement names one action funcd knows, such as kv::read, and its principal and resource scopes name only entity types funcd knows and, for a type with a namespace, ids that begin with the Policy's namespace and a slash. funcd refuses text that does not parse, holds no statement or breaks these rules. |

## OIDCProvider

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `OIDCProvider` |

### `OIDCProvider.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addon` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The add-on object of the namespace that serves the provider: funcd reaches the provider at the engine's own address, while browsers use issuer. |
| `audiences` | array of string values | The aud values a Bearer token may carry to sign a call in. Empty, the default, means that a Bearer token signs nobody in. |
| `client` | object, [`OIDCProvider.spec.client`](#oidcproviderspecclient), required | The sign-in client: set exactly one of registration, a client funcd registers at the provider, and credentialsSecret, a client made by hand. |
| `issuer` | string, required | The provider's issuer URL, as its discovery document names it and as browsers reach it. Without addon, funcd reads the discovery document and every endpoint it names over https only, at addresses reachable from the internet; with addon, at the add-on engine's own address. |
| `sessionSecret` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | A Secret of the namespace whose SESSION_KEY holds 32 random bytes, the key that seals the sign-in cookies. A new key ends every session of the provider. |

### `OIDCProvider.spec.client`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `credentialsSecret` | string, a DNS-1123 label | A Secret of the namespace, written by hand, whose CLIENT_ID and CLIENT_SECRET hold a client made at the provider. |
| `registration` | object, [`OIDCProvider.spec.client.registration`](#oidcproviderspecclientregistration) | funcd registers the client at the provider's registration endpoint, keeps its redirect URIs on the callbacks of the hosts that sign in with the provider, and writes its credentials to a Secret it owns. |

### `OIDCProvider.spec.client.registration`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `credentialSecretName` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The Secret funcd writes the client to, as CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, REGISTRATION_ACCESS_TOKEN and REGISTRATION_CLIENT_URI, and deletes with the provider. Empty means the provider's name. funcd leaves alone a Secret of that name it did not write, and the provider then stays Pending with reason SecretNotOwned. |
| `rotate` | integer, at least 0 | Raise it above status.observedRotate to rotate the client's secret: funcd asks the provider for a new one and stores it. |
| `tokenSecret` | string, a DNS-1123 label | A Secret whose REGISTRATION_TOKEN funcd sends as a Bearer token with every registration, for a provider that requires one. |

### `OIDCProvider.status`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callbacks` | array of string values | The callbacks funcd last applied to the registered client's redirect URIs, sorted. |
| `clientId` | string | The client ID the stored client carries. |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `observedRotate` | integer | The spec.client.registration.rotate value funcd last applied: a rotation is done once it equals rotate. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Deploying`, `Ready`, `Idle`, `Degraded`, `Failed`, `Terminating` | Where the object is in its lifecycle. |
